text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae suffered a severe injury!
We rushed to the nurse's office for treatment, but...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh... I really went and did it, didn't I...?
...This is—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: There's nothing to do but start rehab immediately!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Just think about it.
What if I made a miraculous early comeback from this massive injury...?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, it's guaranteed to create a buzz!
Even if it's a bit of a stretch, we should give it our all.”

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
For Tomakomai's sake,
I'll endure any pain...!
choice_data_list: If I judge that it's dangerous, I'll stop you immediately.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh! But—
choice_data_list: You can't expect good results every time.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ! ...Indeed... that's true.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I can't let bad news reach my hometown...
I'll behave myself, okay...?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Of course! ...I will
definitely make the most of this chance!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, we decided to try a light jog for rehabilitation, but—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —Owwwww...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... This pain is...
...Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm alright.
...I'll be heading back now.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Because I can't let bad news
make its way back home...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Hokko Tarumae took some time off to rest. But her injury was slow to heal, and it would take a long time before she could return...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The migratory bird with paper wings, Hokko Tarumae...
has officially returned!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
My injury is feeling great!
Thanks to the treatment, it doesn't hurt at all.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I need to post an update on social media right away!
To thank the nurse who treated me, and—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: (...Filled with gratitude toward my Trainer, who believed in me...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hokko Tarumae overcame her injury through sheer grit... and made a smooth comeback afterwards!
